Looking for prefabricated houses in Hyderabad? A prefabricated house is a steel-framed home built in a factory and delivered to your plot ready to assemble — a faster, more predictable alternative to conventional construction. SAMAN POS India Private Limited (POS = Portable Office Solutions) manufactures these homes to order and delivers them across Hyderabad and the surrounding HMDA region, factory-direct.

This guide covers where prefab houses make sense around Hyderabad, what SAMAN builds, what it costs, and how delivery works to a Hyderabad site.

Where Prefab Houses Work Around Hyderabad

Hyderabad's expansion has opened up plotted land and site-housing demand along its growth corridors:

  • Genome Valley and the Shameerpet belt — staff accommodation, site offices and weekend homes near the research and industrial parks.
  • Shamshabad airport corridor — plotted developments and farm plots where a quick-to-erect home suits a tight build window.
  • HMDA layout zones on the city's outer ring — affordable plots where a factory-built home avoids long on-site construction cycles.

The advantage across these areas is consistent: a factory-built home arrives finished and is assembled in days, so labour availability and on-site delays matter far less than with conventional construction.

What SAMAN Supplies

SAMAN builds steel-framed prefabricated houses and cabin-format homes on an IS 2062 MS frame with insulated PUF wall and roof panels. Real configurations from our live range:

  • Porta cabin house — a compact factory-built living unit from ₹3,65,000.
  • Portable cabin house — an entry living cabin from ₹2,56,000.
  • Multi-room prefabricated house — larger configured homes from ₹16,25,000, built to your room plan.

Each unit is fabricated to a fixed specification: steel frame, insulated panels, wired and plumbed before dispatch. Warranty is 5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing + 20–25 years engineered service life.

Delivery to a Hyderabad Site

SAMAN manufactures at Gopasandra, Bengaluru 560099 and at our Greater Noida unit, and delivers across India. Bengaluru is a short transport corridor to Hyderabad, so dispatch is direct and there is no local reseller markup — you buy from the manufacturer. Units are assembled on a prepared base at your plot. Share your location and access for a delivery and assembly schedule.

Why Choose a Prefab House in Hyderabad

  • Speed: assembled in days, not the months an RCC house takes.
  • Predictable cost: a fixed factory specification limits the cost surprises of open-ended site work.
  • Durable build: IS 2062 steel frame with insulated panels for Hyderabad's summer heat.
  • Relocatable: a steel-framed home can be dismantled and moved.

Certifications and Manufacturer Credentials

SAMAN POS India Private Limited (POS = Portable Office Solutions) has manufactured steel structures since 2009 (incorporated 2019), with 500+ projects across India from our plants at Gopasandra, Bengaluru 560099 and Greater Noida (Vill Jalpura, Tehsil Dadri, Greater Noida, Gautambudha Nagar, Uttar Pradesh 201308). Certifications and registrations: ISO 9001:2015 (Cert No. E20250218645), ISO 14001:2015 (Cert No. E20250218646), ISO 45001:2018 (Cert No. E20250218647), NSIC enlisted (Ref. NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207), DPIIT-recognised startup (Ref. DIPP56005), Udyam registered (UDYAM-KR-03-0172770), GST 29ABBCS7101B1ZR (Bangalore) and 09ABBCS7101B1ZT (Noida). Structural steel to IS 2062.

Get a Quote for Your Hyderabad Prefab House

Tell us your plot size, room requirement and location. Call +91 88616 22859 or send an enquiry for a factory-direct quote and delivery plan.

FAQs: Prefabricated Houses in Hyderabad

Does SAMAN deliver prefab houses to Hyderabad?
Yes — we manufacture in Bengaluru and Greater Noida and deliver factory-direct across Hyderabad and the HMDA region, including the Genome Valley and Shamshabad corridors.

How much does a prefab house cost?
It depends on size, room count, finish and transport. Real starting points: a porta cabin house from ₹3,65,000, a portable cabin house from ₹2,56,000, and multi-room prefabricated houses from ₹16,25,000.

How long does delivery and assembly take?
Factory-built units assemble on site in days; exact timing depends on size, customisation and distance, confirmed after a site assessment.

Sizes, Specifications and What Is Included

SAMAN prefab houses are built to order, so the plan follows your plot and requirement. Standard inclusions:

  • Structure: primary IS 2062 mild-steel frame, engineered to your load and wind zone.
  • Walls and roof: insulated PUF sandwich panels for Hyderabad's summer heat.
  • Services: electrical wiring with MCB protection, plumbing points, and kitchen/bathroom fit-out provision, completed at the factory.
  • Finish: flooring, partitions and exterior finish to your choice, fixed at order stage.

The home is engineered and assembled indoors, so quality is consistent and on-site work is limited to base preparation and assembly — useful on outer-ring HMDA plots where skilled construction labour can be hard to schedule.

Who Buys Prefab Houses Around Hyderabad

Buyers in the Hyderabad region include plot owners building weekend or retirement homes on the HMDA outer-ring layouts; research and industrial employers in the Genome Valley belt needing quick staff housing or site offices; and farm-plot owners along the Shamshabad corridor. The common driver is a finished, durable, relocatable steel home delivered without the months an RCC build takes.

How Installation Works

The process is simple: we assess your plot size, access and utility points; you confirm the layout and finish; the home is fabricated at the factory; it is delivered on standard transport to your Hyderabad site; and our team assembles it on a prepared, levelled base before handover. Most of the work happens in the factory, so on-site disruption is minimal and the build is not held up by labour scheduling. A steel-framed home can be dismantled and relocated later if your plans change — a flexibility conventional RCC construction cannot match.

Standard or Fully Custom

You can start from a standard configuration and adjust room count, bathroom and kitchen placement, and finish — or specify a fully custom layout. Either way the structure is engineered to your load and wind zone and priced to the final plan, so you know the cost before fabrication begins.
